name: Citizenship by Naturalization

requirements.blocker_text: Code de la Nationalite Algerienne, Article 10: at least 7 years of residence in Algeria at the time of application, continued residence at the time the naturalization decree is signed, good morality with no disqualifying criminal record, and demonstrated assimilation into Algerian society. The Minister of Justice retains discretionary power to reject applications even where the formal conditions are met.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years of residence in Algeria, demonstrate assimilation and good conduct, and apply -- noting the Minister of Justice's discretion applies regardless.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of assimilation into Algerian society
